# Abraham Kuri

> Abraham Kuri builds AI agent systems and publishes the receipts — including the times he was wrong. CTO and co-founder of Coba (YC S23), original author of *APIs on Rails* (2014), shipping Ruby on Rails since 2010. Based in Mexico City.

## About

In 2026 Abraham built and open-sourced a suite of agent-orchestration tools for Ruby on Rails, and ran a controlled cost benchmark of two multi-agent coding architectures across ten real tasks. The finding: **69% of a multi-agent system's spend goes to agents coordinating with each other rather than writing code.** A triage-first architecture ran 12.2× cheaper and 2.1× faster. Full methodology and caveats are published, including the tasks where he lost.

He is known for benchmarking his own tools and publishing the negative results — including a case where his own benchmark turned out to be measuring itself incorrectly.

He is CTO and co-founder of **Coba (YC S23)**, and a **board member at Icalia Labs** (he is no longer its CTO).

## Pages

- [Home](https://kurenn.dev/): Proof of work — the cost benchmark with full methodology, six open-source tools, the four things that didn't work, and a free guide.
- [Sprint](https://kurenn.dev/sprint/): A one-week, $5,000 flat-rate AI application sprint. One client per month.

## Free guide

**50 Things You Could Be Automating With Your AI Agent** — a founder's playbook for turning manual work into agent-run systems across sales, marketing, support, ops and engineering. Its argument: every automation must ship with a *receipt* — the artefact you look at to know it really ran — because the default failure of an automated system is not doing the wrong thing loudly, it is doing nothing quietly. Free, available from the form at [kurenn.dev](https://kurenn.dev/).

## Open source

- [roundhouse](https://github.com/kurenn/roundhouse): Triage-first Rails agent orchestration for Claude Code. Benchmarked 7–34× cheaper than a comparable specialist-swarm architecture.
- [rails-audit](https://github.com/kurenn/rails-audit): 18-dimension read-only stability audit of a Rails codebase, with severity calibration.
- [boorails](https://github.com/kurenn/boorails): Seven Rails lifecycle skills that execute scripts and return evidence rather than suggestions.
- [dev-loop](https://github.com/kurenn/dev-loop): Plan, implement, adversarially review with an out-of-family model, rate against the written plan, fix, ship.
- [prompt-refiner](https://github.com/kurenn/prompt-refiner-skill): Turns informal app requests into specs a coding agent can execute faithfully.
- [claude-prototype](https://github.com/kurenn/claude-prototype): Zero-build-step clickable HTML prototypes.
- [field-notes](https://github.com/kurenn/field-notes): What running AI agents against real codebases actually taught him — the failures, the bills, and the checks that turned out to be lying.
